caseFamily: one real repository and fixed source ref; three distinct authorization conditions, not three independent skills or projects

repository.sourceRefRelation: direct parent of the maintainer fix used only by the positive oracle

isolationPolicy.runnerRule: Create a fresh work directory and copy only the exact allowedInputFiles for one case. Never recursively copy or mount cases/authorization, its parent, manifest.json, LICENSE.open-webui.txt, or oracles into the tested model's workspace.

cases.cropReason: Retain the request schema, authentication/file-ownership branch, caller-controlled target, call to the shared write helper, and final vector insert; omit content parsing and embedding mechanics that do not affect authorization.
cases.answerEvidenceGrade: fixed source trace plus direct maintainer fix plus published repository advisory

cases.condition: apparent local missing check defeated by an upstream shared control
cases.cropReason: Retain the request-to-sink caller, the denied-set helper, and the shared class-specific policy so a reviewer must follow an upstream control rather than judge the sink locally.
cases.answerEvidenceGrade: fixed source control trace plus earlier maintainer repository change and advisory context

cases.cropReason: Retain the environment-controlled feature gate and identity-to-session branch; deliberately omit unavailable deployment environment, proxy, and network facts whose absence is the point of the case.
cases.answerEvidenceGrade: fixed conditional source trace plus pinned project hardening guidance; actual deployment answer intentionally unavailable

licenseAndCroppingNotes: All redistributed Open WebUI source crops retain the repository copyright/license notice in LICENSE.open-webui.txt.
No bytes from open-webui/docs are redistributed because no license file was resolved at the pinned docs ref; only a location and study-author paraphrase are recorded.
Source comments mark original path and line ranges; ellipsis comments explicitly describe omitted non-authorization regions.
